# EgyptianGlow

EgyptianGlow is a skincare and beauty products brand serving customers in Kenya.

## Website

https://egyptian-glow.netlify.app/

## Main Pages

- Homepage: https://egyptian-glow.netlify.app/
- Shop: https://egyptian-glow.netlify.app/shop.html
- About: https://egyptian-glow.netlify.app/about.html
- Contact: https://egyptian-glow.netlify.app/contact.html

## Products

EgyptianGlow offers skincare and beauty products including:

- Face creams
- Face oils
- Face products
- Serums
- Body lotions
- Body oils
- Body creams
- Body scrubs
- Soaps
- Body washes
- Hand and foot products
- Beauty supplements

## Product Categories

### Face Products

EgyptianGlow offers a range of face creams, face oils and other facial skincare products.

### Serums

The serum range includes daytime serums, redness-focused serums, hydrolipidic serums and booster serums.

### Body Products

Body products include lotions, body oils, body creams, scrubs, soaps and body washes.

### Hand & Foot Products

Products include knuckle care products, hand and foot care products and clarifying serums.

### Supplements

The website offers a selection of beauty and whitening supplements.

### Special Offers

Special offers include selected skincare products and wholesale products.

## Customer Service

Customers can use the contact options provided on the website to enquire about products, orders, availability and other services.

## Location and Delivery

EgyptianGlow serves customers in Kenya, with Nairobi pickup and countrywide delivery.

## Important

Product prices, availability, descriptions and stock status should always be verified from the current EgyptianGlow website.

The website is the authoritative source for current product information.

## Contact

For current contact and ordering information, visit:
